templates.name: GoDaddy DNS
templates.description: DNS-01 validation through the GoDaddy DNS API. Supports wildcard certificates.
notes: Use a Production API key and secret, not an OTE (test) key.
GoDaddy limits DNS API access to some account types. If validation fails with ACCESS_DENIED or 403, the GoDaddy account isn't allowed to use the API.
GoDaddy DNS changes can take a few minutes to show up. If validation fails because the TXT record isn't found, raise the DNS sleep.
